title: TileSet Custom Data Layer: Name change does not refresh in tile paint panel; only modifying Type triggers name update
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9201) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255HX (20 threads) - 15.43 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When editing the  Name  of a custom data entry inside TileSet's Custom Data Layer, the field name shown in the left tile paint panel will not refresh automatically and keeps showing the old name.
However, if you modify the  Type  of the same entry (for example, switch int to string and revert it), the name in the paint panel will update to the new name immediately.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create or open a TileSet and navigate to Custom Data Layer.
2. Add a custom data entry: set  Name=hu ,  Type=int .
3. Select a tile and fill a value for this custom property in the paint panel.
4. Go back to Custom Data Layer and change the entry's  Name  to  test .
5. Check the left-side tile paint panel.

Result: The field label still shows the old name  hu , not  test .

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Steps to Reproduce

1. Create or open a TileSet and navigate to Custom Data Layer.
2. Add a custom data entry: set  Name=hu ,  Type=int .
3. Select a tile and fill a value for this custom property in the paint panel.
4. Go back to Custom Data Layer and change the entry's  Name  to  test .
5. Check the left-side tile paint panel.

Result: The field label still shows the old name  hu , not  test .

6. Modify the  Type  of this entry (int → string).

Result: The tile paint panel refreshes, and the label updates to  test .

Expected behavior

Changing the  Name  of a custom data entry should automatically sync and update the label in the tile paint panel, without needing to modify the  Type .

Actual behavior

- Changing only  Name : UI label in paint panel stays at old name, no refresh.
- Changing  Type  (any type switch): triggers full UI refresh, then the new name appears.

Environment

- Godot version: 4.7 stable
- OS: Windows

Additional information

- Reading and writing the custom data value works correctly. This bug only affects the UI label display.
- Re-selecting tiles or switching panels cannot trigger the name refresh. Only changing Type triggers the refresh.

Workaround

As a temporary solution, modify the property Type and revert it after renaming to force the UI to refresh.
